title: Port-Bar
summary: PORT-BAR, noun A bar to secure the ports of a ship in a gale of wind. Port-charges, in commerce, charges to which a ship or its cargo is subjected in a harbor, as wharfage, etc.

inlines.v: PORT-BAR, noun A bar to secure the ports of a ship in a gale of wind. Port-charges, in commerce, charges to which a ship or its cargo is subjected in a harbor, as wharfage, etc.
